narr: A cold front was responsible for afternoon and evening thunderstorms. A few of these thunderstorms caused flash flooding.
ev: Heavy rain was responsible for closing several roads. The roads were flooded and impassable.
NJ511 reported flash flooding on US 130 Northbound, including at and south of CR 543/Beverly Rd.
Route 541 quickly flooded due to heavy rain. All lanes were closed. Two vehicles became stuck in the water.
Flash flooding was reported on East River Drive in Willingboro. Approximately two feet of water covered the roadway.
lsr: NJ511 reports flooding on US 130 Northbound At South of CR 543/Beverly Rd (Burlington Twp).
East River Drive flooded with approximately 2 feet of water.
RT541 is flooded in all lanes - 2 vehicles stuck in water.
